data.name: Hot Plates
data.detailed_description:
Discover the future world of cooking! The chef of the Hot Plates space-restaurant needs to know all about management and how to satisfy his customers personal taste. Organize your kitchen and earn prestige in space. This way more different customers will enjoy your cooking and help you rise to be the best cook in the galaxy.



Hot Plates offers swift gameplay, which rocks the world of creating foods. There is a key to all challenges. The customer likes spicy foods? No Problem! The meats are too chewy? We're up to change that! No matter which race, there is something for whoever may come!
There is lots of equipment to discover for an eager cook who is willing to satisfy all customers wishes. The happier the guests, the more money to earn. The hard earned credits make it possible to buy ingredients or machines for the upcoming days.
Only the best of 'em all will be able to open the restaurant for the most supreme races in space. Only with careful cultivation, organisation and a precise hand while preparing meals you'll be able to obtain a ten-star-restaurant, a restaurant, which was never seen before!

Mechanic/Features

  • Exciting gameplay
  • Preparing and using ingredients for various foods
  • Heat and skill-based cooking determining the quality of the meal and how much it is to the customers liking
  • Discover new or hidden recipes
  • Use the shop to not suffer from well known ingredient shortages
  • Expand your kitchen
  • Buy machines to be prepared for every kind of customer
  • Grow vegetables and breed animals
  • Get to know as yet unknown alien-races
  • Cook for all alien-species according to their individual taste
  • Achieve 10 stars with your kitchen
  • Become the very best space-cook

reviews.review:
This game has SO MUCH of wasted potential that I'm genuinely annoyed by just seeing the state this game has ended with. Gameplay-wise it's a straight-up ripoff of "Overcooked" but without a single thing that made Overcooked enjoyable. There are also other similar games in this genre, but others do introduce something unique, this one does not.

The premise is actually good, I mean it's a ripoff but hey, you run your own restaurant as a sole member and you're serving your dishes. Where is the problem then?

I wonder where to start, maybe we start from what makes this game unplayable in the first place? Bugs and optimization.

Game has absolutely no optimization at all, putting ingredients into a grinder or bowl causes 1-2 seconds freeze, making a "time management" a freaking chore supported with swear words rather than a challenge. Orders can randomly disappear from the list, making you wonder what the fuck you're supposed to prepare in the first place. People can order foods that you can't even possibly cook yet, because you didn't even SEE the missing ingredient in the freaking store, on top of the fact that you lack appropriate machines to make them!

Even more ridiculous is the fact that some dishes have actually ZERO profit rate, they cost exactly the same what we order ingredients for, so it's not even profitable to prepare them in the first place. If I wanted to run a charity organization then that'd be okay, but I thought I'm running a restaurant with making profit in mind? No? Time and effort are free?

Game has absolutely nothing interesting to offer, this could be a really good game if EVERYTHING was polished, from that awful UI, through pricing and balance, ending on bugs and optimizations. For a game in early access I'd forgive all of those quirks and assume that they will be fixed before the release, but this thing looks not only officially released, but abandoned since half of the year as well, making the entire experience the absolute worst.

Even though the price would be OK if the game >worked<, the game doesn't work, and it doesn't look like being fixed anytime soon. There is not even a single reason to grab this game instead of a proper, original "Overcooked" that this game has ripped entire idea from or any other similar game that isn't bugged to death. It's a chore to play it, and constant memory leak and lacking optimization will make you either a restart every few hours, or uninstall, whatever comes first.

All of what I mentioned could be easily fixed in a few weeks tops, and it'd make this game finished to the point of at least being possible to play. This is what annoys me, because the premise is good, there are fundaments and general idea what the game is supposed to offer, but everything is fucked up from top to bottom, offering half-broken tiny part of what the game should be about. I intentionally didn't even start talking about the game itself, because the moment I found out that everything is RNG-based, from lack of meat in the store for several days, to opening previously-bought ticket and receiving different amount of money each time, I knew that this is the moment I should stop being a masochist and uninstall this piece of garbage once for good.

Avoid at all cost. Even bundled price of a dozen cents is too much.

---
